INTRO_KR: The Hong Kong/ Shanghai Data Cooperation Forum cum Open Data Challenge is co-organized by the Office of the Government Chief Information Officer (OGCIO) and the Shanghai Municipal Commission of Economy and Informatization, and is jointly organized by the Organizing Committee of B4B Challenge and SODA Competition. The event is divided into two parts: Hong Kong/ Shanghai Data Cooperation Forum, and Open Data Challenge. INTRO_KR: AlphaPro, incubated by Yuan Valley, an affiliate of the University of Hong Kong, is a pioneer in material solutions. With the robust academic and R&D resources from HKU, we're committed to developing state - of - the - art products. Our product series, including structural adhesive, thermal interface material for sensor as well as radar, and waterproof sealing adhesive, is tailor - made for robots and low - altitude aircraft. In robots, our structural adhesive firmly bonds components. It endures vibrations in industrial robots and maintains the integrity of service robots, ensuring long - term performance. The sensor thermal interface material effectively dissipates heat from sensors, enhancing their accuracy and lifespan, which is vital for robots' environmental perception. For low - altitude aircraft like drones, our waterproof sealing adhesive protects sensitive electronics from moisture and dust during flights. This is essential for stable operations in tasks such as aerial photography, surveying, and delivery. It also secures components in communication and control systems, enabling smooth data transfer.

INTRO_KR: Soundskrit was founded at the startup incubator TandemLaunch bringing together a love for audio and new technology. The three initial founders connected with Professor Ron Miles of Binghamton University and were introduced to a new perspective on MEMS microphones, one grounded in over 30 years of research. Rather than use arrays of non-directional microphones to try and get directionality, why not build the directionality into the hardware itself? These new MEMS microphones were inspired by the spider, which utilized its hairs and webs to hear. In fact, the very first prototype microphone actually used a spider web as the sensing diaphragm! Our technology and company have moved well beyond those early days, though our love for taking inspiration from nature still persists. Today, Soundskrit has significantly miniaturized the first prototype without sacrificing any capabilities to create the highest performance MEMS directional microphone on the market. But while the Soundskrit microphone has shrunk, the team has grown, with offices in both Canada and the United States and a multitude of team members from diverse backgrounds. Our team works tirelessly to create the best MEMS microphone in the industry and change the way audio is captured in our everyday devices.

INTRO_KR: The Highways Department is responsible for the continuous enhancement of Hong Kong's public road network, undertaking the planning, design and management of road projects so as to meet public transport demand and the city's development. We take up the duties of inspection, repair and maintenance of public road facilities to ensure that they are in safe and serviceable condition. In addition, under the policy of developing a public transport-oriented system with railway as the backbone, we are responsible for reviewing Hong Kong's Railway Development Strategy and supervising the implementation of new railway projects. In the course of pressing ahead the implementation of various transport infrastructure projects, the Highways Department is committed to improving the living quality of the community as well. When planning road projects, we strive to integrate more greening elements to beautify the community's streetscape. We also add lifts, escalator links and covers to pedestrian walkways to enhance the walking environment; build noise barriers for roads and develop low noise road surfacing materials to reduce traffic noise nuisance.

NAME_KR: The National Games Coordination Office in Hong Kong
NAME_EN: The National Games Coordination Office in Hong Kong
INTRO_KR: To plan for the organisation of the 15th National Games (NG), as well as the 12th National Games for Persons with Disabilities (NGD) and the 9th National Special Olympic Games (NSOG), to be co-hosted by the Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macao authorities in 2025, the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (SAR) set up the Hong Kong SAR Organising Committee of the 15th National Games in May 2023. The Committee, overseen by the Chief Executive, with the Chief Secretary for Administration as the Chairman and the Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism as the Secretary General, provides policy steer and oversees the preparation for events to be staged in Hong Kong. In October of the same year, the Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau announced the setting up of the National Games Coordination Office (Hong Kong), led by the Head of the National Games Coordination Office (Hong Kong), to fully take on the planning and implementation work of the NG, NGD and NSOG.

INTRO_KR: On August 23, 2023, Chinese President Xi Jinping announced at the 15th BRICS Summit that "China will set up a China-BRICS Science and Innovation Incubation Park for the New Era to support the deployment of innovation results". The China-BRICS SIIP is dedicated to the creation of a thorough and all-encompassing scientific and technological innovation incubation service system, grounded in the harmonious integration of online and offline platforms. It seeks to establish a "cloud incubation" platform, centered on intellectual property, technology transfer, and incubation services, thereby promoting bilateral and multilateral cooperation in the realms of science and innovation incubation among BRICS countries. The "China-BRICS SIIP International Experts Advisory Committee" has been established, forming a "China-BRICS SIIP Collaboration Network On Science, Technology, Innovation, and Incubation". By 2028, the China-BRICS SIIP will be established as a carrier of BRICS cooperation and an international, professional, and branded incubation platform with a profound influence in BRICS countries, with its headquarters in Xiamen, China. It will support the deployment of innovation results among BRICS countries, enabling their widespread and orderly transfer and transformation.
